cases.title: Select available seats and verify dynamic count and total price update
cases.description: Verify that clicking on available seats toggles their selection, increments the selected seat count in data-testid="selected-count", and accurately calculates the total price in data-testid="total-price" based on the selected movie's ticket price.

cases.title: Attempt to select occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked with the occupied class cannot be selected and do not affect the selected seat count or total price calculation.

cases.title: Change selected movie and verify total price recalculation
cases.description: Verify that selecting a different movie from data-testid="movie-select" dynamically updates the total price using the new movie's ticket price while maintaining the current selected seat count.

cases.title: Select and Deselect Available Seats with LocalStorage Update
cases.description: Verify that clicking an available seat (e.g., data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles its selection status, updates the UI and selected seat count/total price, and correctly stores the seat indices in localStorage.

cases.title: Movie Selection and Price Calculation with Specific Options
cases.description: Verify that users can select from specific movie options ('The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', 'No Country for Old Men ($9)') identified by specific data-testids, and that the total price updates correctly based on the chosen movie's ticket price.

cases.title: Prevention of Selecting Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected, do not toggle state when clicked, and are excluded from the seat count and total price calculations.

cases.title: Restore state from localStorage
cases.description: Verify that when localStorage contains 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the page correctly marks the corresponding seats as selected and sets the movie dropdown to the saved index upon loading.

cases.title: Default initialization when localStorage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when localStorage does not contain 'selectedSeats' or 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as selected and the movie dropdown defaults to the first option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Dynamic update of seat count and total price on seat selection and deselection
cases.description: Verify that clicking available seats toggles their selection state, updates the selected seat count at data-testid='selected-count', and recalculates the total price at data-testid='total-price' based on the current movie price. Also verify that deselecting a seat decreases the count and total price accordingly.

cases.title: Total price recalculation upon changing movie selection with active seats
cases.description: Verify that changing the movie selection from the dropdown with data-testid='movie-select' updates the ticket price and correctly recalculates the total price while maintaining the current count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevention of selecting occupied seats
cases.description: Verify that the system prevents users from selecting seats marked with the 'occupied' class and that clicking such seats does not alter the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends are displayed and correspond to correct states
cases.description: Check that legends indicating available, selected, and occupied seats (including data-testid='seat-select') are rendered correctly on the Movie Seat Booking page so users can understand the different seat states.

cases.title: Verify occupied seats are non-interactive and prevent selection
cases.description: Attempt to click on seats marked as occupied and verify that their status does not change to selected and they do not affect the selected seat count or total price.

cases.title: Verify available seats can be clicked to toggle selection and update metrics
cases.description: Click on available seats to select them and verify that the UI updates their visual status, updates the selected seat count, and recalculates the total price accordingly, and clicking them again deselects them.

analysis.analysis: Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-1 defines the core interaction model: clicking available seats toggles selection, updating data-testid="selected-count" and data-testid="total-price" (count * movie price). Occupied seats cannot be selected or affect metrics. Movie selection via data-testid="movie-select" updates ticket price dynamically. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-2 specifies explicit movie options with values/prices (The Big Lebowski $10, Fargo $12, O Brother $8, No Country for Old Men $9), specific seat IDs (e.g., data-testid="seat-1-1"), toggling status, storing state indices in localStorage, and deselection mechanics. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-3 specifies initialization behavior using localStorage keys 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex'. If present, restore UI selection state and dropdown value; if absent, default to no selected seats and the first movie option ('The Big Lebowski ($10)'). Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-4 reinforces dynamic updates of count and total price, recalculation when switching movies with active selections, and strict prevention of selecting occupied seats. Requirement e2edev_bench_03-R-5 introduces status legends (e.g., data-testid = 'seat-select') for available, selected, and occupied seats, ensuring non-interactivity for occupied states.

coverage.feedback: The accepted cases provide comprehensive coverage across all five requirements (R-1 through R-5), adequately addressing seat selection, deselection, occupied seat prevention, movie dropdown price updates, local storage persistence and default states, and the UI legends. There are no notable coverage gaps. However, there is some minor repetition and overlap between the test cases—for instance, verifying the prevention of selecting occupied seats is tested across multiple cases (G-002, G-006, G-011, and G-013), and dynamic seat selection with count/price updates is similarly duplicated across G-001, G-004, G-009, and G-014. While this redundancy ensures thoroughness, future test suites could combine these overlapping assertions to streamline execution without losing test coverage.
